questions.question: How should the audit's findings be recorded?

options.label: Audit doc + items (Recommended)
options.description: One sdd/ audit doc holding this evidence; backlog items for T1–T19 only, lower-ranked rows stay in the doc. Durable and indexed without flooding BACKLOG.

options.label: Backlog items only
options.description: One item per T-row (≈19), no audit doc. Evidence lives in dossiers; the 28 lower-ranked rows are dropped or folded.

options.label: Audit doc only
options.description: Record everything in one doc, file no items yet. Cheapest, but nothing is scheduled.

options.label: Nothing yet
options.description: Keep the scratch file; you triage later from chat.

questions.question: Which findings must land before D3 step 2 (the next driver copies the template)?

options.label: T1,T2,T4,T5,T9,T10 (Recommended)

options.label: All T1–T19
options.description: Template fully consistent first; delays step 2 noticeably.

options.label: Only T1 and T2
options.description: The two HIGH silent-corruption/no-op defects; everything else rides later steps.

questions.question: T7: kernel glob refusal through an item — which side moves?

options.label: Kernel follows A.5/A.8 (Recommended)
options.description: glob gets the listing's first-page probe over its literal prefix; amend test_condition_space; consistent with every listing. Could widen BK-439.

options.label: Narrow A.5 prose
options.description: Spec says only the listing bound applies to glob; test and code stay. Glob through an item keeps raising.

questions.question: T6: what does LAZY_READ mean for an async backend?

options.label: Per-chunk pull; drop from AsyncMemory (Recommended)
options.description: Matches BE-003/SIO-009 wording; AsyncMemory and its e2e carve-out lose the flag; MEM-003 amended.

options.label: Deferred open is enough
options.description: Redefine async LAZY_READ as 'nothing fetched before first iteration'; amend BE-003 for async; AsyncMemory keeps it.

answers.T6: what does LAZY_READ mean for an asyn: Which one is long term right and matches streaming promise without memory getting blown up?

questions.question: Which conceptual piece should come first?

options.label: Observation contract (Recommended)
options.description: Draft the A.8 driver obligations table: each fact the kernel takes from a driver, kernel-check or driver-owed. Feeds T9/T10/T13/T16 directly; highest leverage per step.

options.label: Glob tree definition
options.description: One defining clause plus a dialect decision; resolves T7 and frames T8, BK-439, BK-447.

options.label: Dafny model's role
options.description: Decide whether the model gates driver acceptance (then BK-434 refinement) or is a scoped reference (then patch T3/T13/T14 only).

options.label: None yet
options.description: Keep the audit as the record; revisit when D3 step 2 is planned.

How should the doc be adapted before review?

options.label: Fix overclaim + commit probes (Recommended)
options.description: Per-finding verification status (re-run / line opened / agent-measured), Method reworded; probe scripts committed under sdd/audits/audit-023-probes/ with a run line each, so a reviewer can re-execute every quoted output.

options.label: Fix overclaim only
options.description: Verification status per finding and the Method sentence; probes stay ephemeral, outputs quoted inline as now.

options.label: Fix + re-verify all
options.description: Re-run or open every agent-only finding myself so every row becomes 'verified', then fix the Method sentence and commit probes.

questions.question: After adapting, how should it be reviewed?

options.label: Open PR, run /rvw-pr (Recommended)
options.description: PR via /pr for the branch, then a /rvw-pr pass on the audit doc; findings posted inline on the PR.

options.label: Local review only
options.description: An independent read-only reviewer agent checks the doc against repo rules and evidence; no PR yet.

options.label: You review it
options.description: I stop after adapting and pushing; you read it first.
